'''Towards the Dream of the Future''' (Korean: '''미래의 꿈을 향해''' ''Mirae-ui Kkum-eul Hyanghae'') is the fourth opening theme for the Korean dub of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon]]''. It debuted with [[SM091]], replacing [[Meeting You Shining]]. It uses the same footage as its corresponding Japanese opening theme, [[Your Adventure]].

The song was [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XZApRsbSfc8 uploaded] to the official Korean Pokémon YouTube channel on March 8, 2019.

==Opening animation==
===Synopsis===
The opening begins with [[Ash's Pikachu]] waking up and yawning as {{Ash}} beckons it to come with him. Pikachu jumps onto Ash's shoulders just before Ash leaps off a cliff and into the waters below. After the series logo is shown, Ash and Pikachu are shown walking with the Pokémon Ash caught or took care of while in [[Alola]]. As they walk, a film reel containing scenes of Ash and his Pokémon are shown behind them.

Ash sadly looks upon a {{i|Poké Ball}} at sunset, only for {{ashcl}} to appear and show that they are there to support him. Ash then happily runs towards them, causing {{an|Sophocles}} to fall over as he tries to dodge Ash. At the [[Pokémon School]], Ash struggles to understand a book during a class, gives up and puts his head on the desk, and is nudged by {{an|Professor Kukui}} to get him to continue. At night, Ash and his Pokémon play together on a beach. At daytime, Ash lays down on a patch of grass with Pikachu, looking at a rainbow in the cloudy skies.

Kiawe and his Pokémon train at home, {{an|Lana}} and {{TP|Lana|Primarina}} (formerly her Popplio) look at the sea while sitting on some rocks, {{an|Mallow}} and {{TP|Mallow|Tsareena}} are wearing their aprons at [[Aina's Kitchen]], Sophocles, {{TP|Sophocles|Togedemaru}}, and {{TP|Sophocles|Vikavolt}} (formerly his Charjabug) look at the night sky, and {{an|Lillie}} strokes a sleeping [[Snowy]] at her house. In a rocky location, Ash pulls his hat back and sends out {{AP|Lycanroc}} to battle [[Gladion's Lycanroc]]. [[Ash's Rowlet]] and [[Hau]]'s {{p|Dartrix}} fly past Hau before taking to the skies. {{AP|Torracat}} then battles the [[Professor Kukui's Incineroar|Masked Royal's Incineroar]] before Pikachu battles a {{p|Zeraora}}.

{{TRT}} and {{TP|Jessie|Wobbuffet}} fantasize about sitting with {{an|Giovanni}} before {{an|Bewear}} crashes into the [[malasada]] truck and squishes their faces into the windshield. At Professor Kukui's house, Ash grabs his backpack and prepares to leave while Rowlet gives a thumbs up to the viewers. In the first variant, {{al|Dia}} and {{p|Zeraora}} save Ash from a {{p|Guzzlord}}. In the second variant, Professor Kukui stands in front of the construction site of the Alola League, and envisions himself (as the Masked Royal) and Ash battling there. One final shot of the main cast is presented.
